Salman And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18
September, 2023

Author: Prakash Padia
Bench: Prakash Padia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:179381
Court No. - 4
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 34484 of 2023
Applicant :- Salman And 2 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Zafeer Ahmad
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Prakash Padia,J.
1.
Short Counter affidavit has been filed today by Sri Istyak Khan, learned counsel appearing on behalf of opposite party no. 2.
The same is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for opposite party and learned A.G.A.
for the State.
3.

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the chargesheet dated 13.9.2022,
cognizance/summoning order dated 13.7.2023 as well as entire proceeding of Case No.553/9/2023,
C.N.R. No. 030352/2023 (State vs. Salman and others) arising out of Case Crime No.453 of 2022 Salman And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188676909/
1 under Sections- 498A, 323, 504, 506, 328 IPC Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, and Section 3/4 of Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) and the applicant nos. 2 and 3 were summoned under Sections- 498A, 323, 504, 506, 328 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station- Civil Lines,
District Moradabad on the basis of compromise deed dated 10.8.2023.

entities.text: Salman And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have reconciled their differences and a compromise have entered between them which has been reduced in writing.
Copy of the same is annexed as Annexure No.(4) to the present application.
It is further submitted that a copy of the compromise has already been filed by the parties before the court below.
4. Learned AGA appearing for the opposite party no. 1 does not dispute the correctness of the aforesaid submission made by learned counsel for the applicants.
6. The facts regarding compromise has also been narrated in the short counter affidavit filed today on behalf of the opposite party no.2.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, parties are directed to produce a copy of this order along with other necessary papers/documents before the court below within a period of three weeks from today.
The court below is directed to fix a date for the verification of the compromise dated 10.8.2023 entered into between the parties and pass an appropriate order to that effect within next six weeks.
7. In view of the above, the present application is disposed of.
8. For a period of two months or till the final order passed on the compromise application by the court below whichever is earlier, no coercive measure shall be taken against the applicants.
9. In case, the applicants are still aggrieved or if no action is taken, it will be open for the applicants to approach this Court afresh.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 S.K.
